title: Clayface Trailer: Body Horror Reshapes the DCU Strategy
excerpt: The debut trailer for DC's Clayface provides a visceral showcase of body horror, pushing the boundaries of superhero storytelling and VFX technology. We analyze the film's strategic significance, its origins in the 1992 'Feat of Clay' episode, and what it means for the DCU's 'Gods and Monsters' technical and narrative roadmap.
description: The Clayface trailer uses body horror and cutting-edge VFX to redefine the DCU. Drawing from 'Feat of Clay,' it signals a new era for DC's Gods & Monsters strategy.
